title: /less-permission-prompts — Automatic Permission Allowlist Builder
description: New built-in /less-permission-prompts skill (v2.1.111) that scans session transcripts and proposes a permission allowlist based on detected patterns. Automates the manual process of building an allowlist for Auto Mode — instead of adding allow rules one by one after encountering prompts, Claude analyzes transcripts and drafts the full allowlist in one pass. Directly complements the Auto Mode feature already in the registry (permissions.defaultMode: 'auto'). Removes the last friction point in Auto Mode adoption: knowing which rules to add. Already available as a local skill in ~/.claude/skills/less-permission-prompts/ — evaluate whether built-in version supersedes the local one.
redundancy_check: IMPROVEMENT:Claude Code Auto Mode — Auto Mode is already in registry; this is the companion that automates allowlist creation. Also check against local ~/.claude/skills/less-permission-prompts/ to determine if built-in supersedes it.
priority: high — closes the Auto Mode adoption friction loop
